descriptionChirho: Piel: to show compassion, mercy, or pity toward someone, used of both God and humans exercising active tenderness and care
Piel participle used substantively or adjectivally to describe one who characteristically shows compassion or mercy
Pual: to receive or obtain mercy, to be the object of compassion from another
Pual perfect 3fs used as the symbolic personal name Ruhamah ('she has been shown mercy') in Hosea, contrasting with Lo-Ruhamah
Qal: to love, expressing deep affection or tender love, distinct from the Piel sense of showing compassion or mercy
